_comment: Levels, labels and customs [VERIFY] with a teacher of the country before the preset is advertised (PLAN.md 9.41). Gimnázium (four years, the 9. to the 12. évfolyam), written 9.a like hu-altalanos; many schools write 9.A with a capital, and the entry year of a language-preparatory class is 9.Ny (nyelvi előkészítő évfolyam) with a thirteenth year (13. évfolyam) [VERIFY]. The six-year (from the 7.) and eight-year (from the 5.) gimnázium keep the pupils in one school: add the levels 5 to 8 of hu-altalanos [VERIFY]. Technikum and szakképző iskola (vocational, five years since the 2020 reform) are not covered [VERIFY]. The school year starts on 1 September, as in hu-altalanos [VERIFY]. After the 12. évfolyam a pupil leaves (érettségi).
